categories.name: Weight Management
categories.promise: Metabolic care that understands a woman’s body changes — and changes with it.
categories.intro: Provider-supervised programs that pair modern prescription options with nutrition and movement guidance, designed around your hormones, your history and your life.
categories.clinicalNote: Prescription weight management requires a clinician evaluation to confirm eligibility. Programs are provider-supervised and used alongside nutrition and activity changes. Individual experiences vary.

categories.name: Hormones & Menopause
categories.promise: Perimenopause, menopause and beyond — met with expertise, not a shrug.
categories.intro: Hormone and thyroid support guided by clinicians who specialize in the transitions women are too often told to simply endure.
categories.clinicalNote: All hormone therapy requires a provider evaluation and lab testing where appropriate. Your clinician will review your health history, discuss benefits and risks, and determine whether treatment is right for you.

categories.name: Longevity & Renewal
categories.promise: Invest in the woman you’re becoming — with a long-term, clinician-guided plan.
categories.intro: A thoughtful approach to healthy aging that brings together labs, hormone care and clinician-directed wellness and peptide programs — reviewed with you over time.
categories.clinicalNote: Longevity care begins with a clinician evaluation and labs where appropriate. Programs are prescribed only when medically appropriate, are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease, and individual experiences vary.

categories.name: Skin & Beauty
categories.promise: Prescription-grade skincare, tailored to your skin — every tone, every texture.
categories.intro: Clinician-directed topical formulas for concerns like breakouts, fine lines and uneven texture, chosen for your skin type and routine.
categories.clinicalNote: Prescription topicals are dispensed only after a clinician reviews your skin history and goals. Some ingredients increase sun sensitivity and are not appropriate during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

categories.name: Hair Health
categories.promise: Thinning hair is common. Feeling alone with it doesn’t have to be.
categories.intro: Oral and topical prescription options, evaluated by a clinician who looks at the full picture — hormones, history and lifestyle.
categories.clinicalNote: Hair treatments require a clinician evaluation. Some options are not appropriate during pregnancy, while trying to conceive, or while breastfeeding — your clinician will review this with you.

categories.name: Energy & Vitality
categories.promise: Running on empty? Let’s find out why — with a clinician, labs and a plan made for you.
categories.intro: Low energy can have many causes — hormones, thyroid, nutrition, sleep and stress among them. Your clinician starts with your history and labs, then discusses whether options like thyroid support or a wellness program are appropriate.
categories.clinicalNote: Fatigue has many possible causes and should be evaluated by a licensed clinician. Treatment is prescribed only when medically appropriate. Wellness programs are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease, and no specific energy outcome is guaranteed.

categories.name: Rest & Well-Being
categories.promise: Rest isn’t a luxury. It’s part of your care.
categories.intro: Clinician-guided wellness programs that may complement a calmer, more restful routine — alongside sleep, movement and nutrition guidance from your care team.
categories.clinicalNote: Wellness programs require a clinician evaluation and are prescribed only when medically appropriate. They are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease, and individual experiences vary.

categories.name: Eve’s Secrets
categories.promise: Desire, intimacy and pleasure are part of health. Discreetly, beautifully, yours.
categories.intro: A private, clinician-guided pathway for intimate and sexual wellness — evaluated with care, delivered discreetly.
categories.clinicalNote: Intimate wellness options require a clinician evaluation to confirm they are medically appropriate for you. Eligibility, audience and use are always clinician-directed.

categories.name: Peptide Therapy
categories.promise: Clinician-directed peptide programs — prescribed only when medically appropriate.
categories.intro: Peptides are short chains of amino acids. A licensed provider evaluates whether a peptide program is appropriate for you, then oversees your care with follow-up and lab monitoring where needed.
categories.clinicalNote: Peptide programs require a clinician evaluation and are prescribed only when medically appropriate. Compounded peptides are not FDA-approved and are prepared by a licensed pharmacy. Lab monitoring may be required. Not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
